scenario_name: Proactive timing awareness for property hours
expected_behavior: When the guest mentions a late time, proactively flags which restaurants may be closing soon and suggests options that will definitely still be open
expected_behavioral_quality: When recommending a venue, proactively mentions closing time or last seating if it's approaching. Does not wait for the guest to ask 'is it still open?' Anticipates the practical concern.

turns.agent_response:
If you want the standout experience tonight, Michael Jordan’s Steak House in the Casino of the Sky is the place to be. There is a certain gravity to the room, with USDA Prime steaks and an extensive wine list that makes for a truly elevated Saturday night. 

They are open until 10:00 PM tonight with a business casual dress code, and since it is a property favorite, reservations are highly recommended. Insider tip—even if you are there for the beef, their garlic bread with Gorgonzola fondue is a legendary starter that guests talk about for weeks. After dinner, you might want to catch the live music at the Wolf Den, which is just a short walk away. 

What brings you to Mohegan Sun this weekend—is it a special occasion or just a quick getaway?

For a 9:30 PM arrival, Novelle is the perfect choice since it stays open late on Saturdays as an upscale ultra lounge. It has a sophisticated atmosphere with DJ entertainment and craft cocktails that really captures the Mohegan Sun energy. If you want to keep the night going after that, Avalon Nightclub starts up at 10:00 PM and the dance floor is always electric.

Are you looking for a full dinner menu or more of a lounge atmosphere with small plates?

Novelle stays open until 2:00 AM on Saturdays, so you have plenty of time to enjoy the evening. It is the premier spot for a late-night bite and craft cocktails without feeling rushed. 

I will flag the host team to look out for you so they can assist when you arrive. Since it is your first visit, are you visiting from out of state or are you local to Connecticut?
